verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs describe privacy-related data controls — filtering sensitive fields before they're sent to Raygun and disabling IP address storage — but these are about limiting what error/application data is captured, not a general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out for the platform itself or for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, documentation addressing AI-native or agent usage tracking, and any independent confirmation of a full opt-out capability.
